introduction: Explore the Court's four seasonal favors, distinct admission tokens and independent brook, soul, stone and lost-wand requests. Active, ready accounting is required. Current proof and accepted deliveries remain separate from first recovery, seasonal rituals, safe access and a personal audience with the Muse.
orientation: Enter the twisted path from the surface and examine the stone arch. The enchanted arch responds to enter, leading into the seasonal forest; its poetic inscription is lore, without a reviewed learned-word quest gate. The traveller's journal on the approach also serves as an exact cave-door key.

Four independent favors give four distinct tokens: the frost thief's perfect snowflake for Sieck; Tookles' sunflower-petal pouch for Kithaya; Grielda's perfect dew drop for Kithapa; and the hollowed-out stump's perfect red leaf for Zialh. Each has its own delivery receipt and native experience reward. Narrated storms, daylight, spring ritual and decay are not extra checked milestones.

The red leaf lies at the top of the hollowed-out stump. Search for the secret, closed stump entrance and open it, or enter the dying stump from the clearing to reach the roots and climb. No personal harvest or leaf from another tree replaces the exact proof.

Offer one Spring, Autumn, Summer and Winter token together to the priestess in the dream tree for the fae key. Matching supplied tokens fit without your earlier personal favor receipts. Four copies of one season do not fit; receipts cannot restore spent tokens.

Search for the secret branches above the priestess, unlock the pickproof door with the fae key, and open the passage. The key has a declared break chance of one hundred percent, with actual destruction subject to accounting acceptance. From the ethereal branch, enter the shimmering portal to the Muse's court. Normal reciprocal unlocking/opening permits return, and the court has a down exit; reset/restart return episodes still need qualification.

Two instances of the imaginary friend follow the Spring and Summer children. Either accepts one obsidian rock for sunshine through the same outcome. Bitter sprites, an autumn satyr and autumn nymphs have declared rocks. The request narrates a skipping lesson without actually recording one.

Kyra accepts a lost-soul essence for decay. Eight initial satyr/sprite sources carry it; later same-named creatures do not all receive it. This is ordinary exact item proof, without a required player death or soul extraction. Sunshine and decay are potion rewards; drinking them is separate from delivery.

Bring twelve exact koi scales together to the fisherman for the necklace. Fifteen fish-and-scale declarations provide sufficient declared quantity across the brook; live supply is not guaranteed. He retires after acceptance. Currents and falling at the waterfall affect access; fishing text does not define an actual catch objective.

Larissa's description asks for the diamond-encrusted wand. It lies on the birch tree's thin ice floor in winter; that room and its upper canopy can cause falling. Return this exact wand to her for the diamond stud. Wandering encounter and first recovery need their own evidence.

The waterfall object responds to jump waterfall and leads to the still cave. Two secret, locked, pickable cave doors use the traveller's journal and the perfect dew drop as exact keys, despite locket-shaped prose clues. Door code accepts those objects without requiring key item type. Use the dew gate before offering that copy if desired; cave exploration is optional and does not block supplied seasonal tokens.

The ledge below the Pegasus cliff has an enter seasonal portal to the Wheel of Time, then the dream tree. World-file value four alone is not a secret exit: the loader masks door type and reset commands set secrecy. Passage, secret discovery, portal arrival and survival are guidance rather than journal credit.

Fiera's shop sells an ordinary apple. Sieck, Pegasus and Kyra have shared class-matched level/runestone guidance from their teacher flags, without local epic-teaching contracts. The Muse, poetic lore and Zialh's elk heart do not supply a reviewed finale. Some seasonal tokens and the diamond stud have pickup-trap metadata; intended trap values and safe retrieval need qualification, not extra achievements.
